Subject: Nexera Order Form redlines (pricing + payment)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached are our legal team's redlines to the order form and a pricing spreadsheet showing how we'd like the minimum commit to be phased over Q2–Q4. High level asks are:

- Flatten the minimum commit to a quarterly tranche instead of a single annual charge.
- Net terms: propose Net 45 instead of Net 30 (our standard).
- VAT/residency: confirm whether Redwood will issue invoices from US entity or AO entity for EU customers.

I've attached Nexera_OrderForm_Redlines_v3.pdf and the pricing schedule. Contracts copied in this thread (contracts@nexerahealth.com) will do the formal redline tracking.

Can your legal ops and finance confirm if Redwood can accept the Net 45 and the tranche billing with a single PO per quarter? If not, what are the alternatives?

Thanks,

Sara O'Neill
Head of Procurement
Nexera Health

Attachments: Nexera_OrderForm_Redlines_v3.pdf (application/pdf), Nexera_pricing_schedule_q2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Sara —

Appreciate the clear redlines and the tranche example. Quick read-through and next steps from our side:

1) Legal: Ben (cc) will triage the redlines; we usually accept phased invoicing but need to confirm the billing entity and whether that affects withholding/VAT handling.
2) Finance: Lauren (cc) will confirm Net 45 feasibility and whether we can apply a single quarterly PO per tranche or if we require separate invoices per deliverable.
3) Ops: If there are no product-level changes, we can map the trimestral tranches to our activation schedule and provide an invoice cadence.

Ben / Lauren — can you both take the redline PDF and the pricing spreadsheet, summarize the blockers (if any), and propose language we can send back to Nexera by EOD tomorrow? Sara — we'll aim to return a tracked changes version and a short counter-proposal on payment timings.

Also flagging a small commercial ask: Nexera requested a reduced per-token rate on the second tranche once usage > 1.2M tokens/mo. I'll have Ben call that out in the commercial summary so we can decide whether to accept, counter, or offer a usage credit.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redline_Summary_KP_comments.docx (summary with commercial note)

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: sara.oneill@nexerahealth.com, contracts@nexerahealth.com, mike.tang@nexerahealth.com

Subject: Re: Nexera Order Form redlines (pricing + payment)

Thanks Kimberly — quick internal triage below and proposed counter language.

Summary of legal points:
- MSA: Nexera removed Redwood's liability cap in one clause; we cannot accept unlimited liability. Propose restoring a liability cap at 3x fees, carveouts for fraud and gross negligence retained.
- Invoicing: We can support quarterly invoicing tied to a single PO per quarter, but invoices will still be issued per invoice event (i.e., one invoice at quarter-end). We need Nexera to confirm acceptance of invoice-level dates for SOW triggers.
- Net terms: Net 45 is acceptable for Enterprise customers with an approved credit profile. We need the finance team to sign off (Lauren).

Commercial counter-proposal (draft language to send to Nexera):
- Minimum commit remains as requested (phased quarterly tranches of $XXX,XXX per quarter).
- Invoices will be issued at quarter close and payable Net 45. Each quarter's invoice will reference the PO number for that tranche.
- Usage overage pricing: if average usage exceeds 1.2M tokens/mo for any calendar month, we will apply an overage rate of $0.XX per 1k tokens for that month. Alternatively, offer a one-time usage credit equal to 10% of the month's overage for the first quarter as a trial concession.
- Liability cap: Limited to 3x fees except for excluded liabilities.

Lauren — can you confirm Net 45 and whether accounting needs any additional fields on the PO (entity ID) to process? If it's approved, I will create a tracked-changes PDF and a short summary doc (to avoid chasing wording).

Ben Carter
Principal, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Ben_counter_redlines_v1.pdf (will attach when prepared)

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: sara.oneill@nexerahealth.com, contracts@nexerahealth.com, mike.tang@nexerahealth.com
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nexera Order Form redlines (pricing + payment)

All — quick finance confirmation. Net 45 is OK for Nexera pending completed credit check (we already have their profile in HubSpot), and we can accept one PO per quarter with invoice referencing the PO. Action items: 

- Lauren to run credit check and confirm by 3/16 COB.
- Ben to circulate a tracked-changes order form and include the liability cap language.
- Kimberly to send the commercial counter with the one-time usage credit option.
- Sara / Nexera contracts to confirm acceptance of invoices issued from Redwood US entity (invoices will show Redwood Inc., EIN xxxxxxx).

Sara — if you can confirm the PO fields your AP team will include (PO number, billing address, entity name), we can prepare invoices to match. If agreed, I'll also attach a DocuSign link for signature-ready order form.

Thanks —

Lauren Bishop
